facts.fact: The EITI Board decision of 12 November 2024 states that Mauritania EITI, the government-backed multi-stakeholder body set up by Decree 2018-135, makes extractive revenue, production and export data available on its Data Warehouse portal with data sets downloadable in CSV; the date is the decision's, as it describes the portal running.
The Board decision reports that Mauritania EITI's outcomes template cites three 2023 news articles (Agence Ecofin, taqas.net, Mines actu), two of which make use of EITI data.

note: No open licence stated (Board recommends stating the reuse licence); no count of publishing bodies.
